title: Deliver Iron Ore to Great Brenwood Steel Mill
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Iron Ore** delivered to **Great Brenwood Steel Mill** (industry id 29, near tile 53,212).

A likely supplier is **Fudham Iron Ore Mine** (industry id 15, near tile 32,206); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.
